organic_results.title: React 19 Release Notes - React.dev
organic_results.snippet: In React 19, you can now access ref as a prop for function components: function MyInput({placeholder, ref}) { ... }. In future versions, forwardRef will be deprecated and removed. We recommend updating your components to use ref as a prop.

organic_results.title: forwardRef - React Reference Docs
organic_results.snippet: forwardRef lets your component expose a DOM node to a parent component with a ref. Note: Starting with React 19, forwardRef is no longer necessary. Pass ref directly as a prop instead.

organic_results.title: How to Upgrade to React 19 - React.dev
organic_results.snippet: React 19 codemod updates forwardRef to regular function components with ref props automatically. forwardRef is deprecated in favor of ref as a prop.
